$comment: BEAN FX release-qualification blocked-suite registry (M41 Phase F / M42-A). A suite listed here is a REQUIRED suite that cannot run in the current environment for an evidence-classified infrastructure or owner-dependency reason. Blocked suites are NEVER counted as passes: any blocked entry forces the release verdict to BLOCKED BY OWNER / INFRASTRUCTURE (or QUALIFIED WITH DOCUMENTED LIMITATIONS only when ownerApproved=true AND zero product failures). Keep this list minimal — every entry needs an evidence pointer in 'evidence'. An empty list means the stage-2 suite set must be fully green for a QUALIFIED verdict.

schema.suite: test file basename, exactly as release-qualify records it
schema.reason: one-line evidence-classified reason (PRODUCT DEFECT | TEST HARNESS DEFECT | ENVIRONMENT/INFRASTRUCTURE BLOCKED | FLAKY/NON-DETERMINISTIC)
schema.requiredInfrastructure: what must be available for the suite to run
schema.evidence: path to logs/classification that justifies the entry
schema.ownerApproved: true only after explicit owner sign-off; never defaulted
